macros.name: CycleNumber
macros.doc: \CycleNumber[⟨ordinal number⟩] (optional; preset empty) specifies the ordinal number of the program cycle; at ScuDo it is a mandatory information.

macros.name: eu
macros.doc: \eu inserts the Napier number symbol “e” in upright type; since this entity is not a variable, but it is a mathematical constant, the iso regulations require it to be typeset in upright type.

macros.name: ExaminationDate
macros.doc: \ExaminationDate{⟨examination date⟩} (preset empty) specifies the date when the examination is to take place.

macros.name: ExaminerList
macros.doc: \ExaminerList{⟨list of examiners⟩} (preset empty) specifies the list of examiners, one per line, each line terminated by \\; each line contains the academic title, the name(s) and surname(s), the role (referee for the supervisors; nothing for the other examiners), the academic institution they belong to – full official institution name, city and country.

macros.name: gei
macros.doc: \gei inserts the imaginary unit in upright type with the “spelling” used by the Italian technologists: “j”.

macros.name: Nlocation
macros.doc: \Nlocation{⟨examination location⟩} (preset: Politecnico di Torino) specifies the institution where the examination takes place.

macros.name: PhDschoolLogo
macros.doc: \PhDschoolLogo⟨logo file name⟩ (preset: Logo-Scudo) selects an image specified with ⟨logo file name⟩ to insert the school logo; a file logo Logo-Scudo.jpg is available from the ScuDo doctoral school; the students must ask such logo file from the Student Office, because such file is a legal property of the School and can be used only with permission.

macros.name: ProgramName
macros.doc: \ProgramName{⟨program name⟩} (mandatory: preset empty) specifies the degree course name.

macros.name: setlogodistance
macros.doc: \setlogodistance{⟨distance⟩} sets the distance between adjacent university logos, if more than one are used.

macros.name: Signature
macros.doc: \Signature{⟨the author’s signature field⟩} (preset: a few lines where the city is preset to “Turin”, and the date is assumed to be equal to the examination date; also the signer name is assumed equal to that of the dissertation author) specifies a different layout of the signature field.

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: \subtitle{⟨dissertation subtitle⟩} (the whole command with its argument is optional) if used, it adds a subtitle.

macros.name: SupervisorList
macros.doc: \SupervisorList{⟨list of supervisors⟩} (mandatory: preset empty) specifies the list of supervisors, one per line, with a \\ at the end of each line; the name(s) and surname(s) are preceded by their academic title, and followed by their role as supervisor, or co-supervisor.

envs.name: ThesisTitlePage
envs.doc: ThesisTitlePage is the environment within which the title page data are specified; some data are preset to default values; some data receive global definitions so that they remain available for setting up some metadata.
